item.title: CVE-2026-135228 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | A vulnerability in the MongoDB integration package for the Laravel framework allows an unauthorized user to bypass mass assignment attribute protections. When an application uses attribute deny-lists to guard sensitive model fields, specially crafted request payloads containing database operator keys can circumvent these protections. An unauthorized user with network access to an affected application endpoint can modify guarded attributes, potentially leading to privilege escalation within the application

item.title: CVE-2026-135399 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Ever Gauzy is an open source business management platform for ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, and project management. Prior to 111.42.10, RoleGuard authorizes requests using the role claim embedded in an access token instead of the user's current database role in packages/core/src/lib/core/context/request-context.ts through RequestContext.hasRoles. After an administrator demotes a user, an already-issued token can continue to pass role checks for up to the token's 24-hour default lifetime, including on DELETE /api/tenant and other RolesEnum.SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN guarded routes, which can preserve tenant-destructive and billing privileges after revocation. This issue is fixed in version 111.42.10.

item.title: CVE-2026-135400 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 9.8
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 9.8 | Ever Gauzy is an open source business management platform for ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, and project management. Prior to 111.44.3, per-request JWT validation in packages/core/src/lib/auth/strategies/jwt.strategy.ts accepts the result of UserService.getIfExists in packages/core/src/lib/user/user.service.ts without requiring User.isActive to be true and User.isArchived to be false. When a token contains an organizationId claim, the active and archived status check applies to the UserOrganization record rather than the User entity. After an administrator deactivates an account through PATCH /api/user/:id, an existing access token can continue to authenticate API requests at the account's previous privilege level until expiration, up to 24 hours by default. This issue is fixed in version 111.44.3.

item.title: CVE-2026-135401 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | Ever Gauzy is an open source business management platform for ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, and project management. Prior to 111.42.9, OrganizationPermissionGuard in packages/core/src/lib/shared/guards/organization-permission.guard.ts checks allowManualTime, allowModifyTime, and allowDeleteTime only when the caller's role is EMPLOYEE and unconditionally authorizes other roles. A tenant administrator who grants ALLOW_MANUAL_TIME, ALLOW_MODIFY_TIME, or ALLOW_DELETE_TIME to MANAGER, DATA_ENTRY, VIEWER, or another non-employee role can therefore leave the organization-wide policy disabled while that role still creates, modifies, or deletes time records, undermining payroll and billing integrity. This issue is fixed in version 111.42.9.

item.title: CVE-2026-135402 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.6
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.6 | Ever Gauzy is an open source business management platform for ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, and project management. Prior to 111.42.13, POST /api/integration/github/webhook in packages/plugins/integration-github/src/lib/probot/probot.discovery.ts passes request bodies through ProbotDiscovery.receiveHook to probot.receive without verifying x-hub-signature-256 against the configured webhook secret. Because the route is public and uses the attacker-controlled installation.id to locate integrations, an unauthenticated remote attacker who knows or guesses an installation identifier can forge installation deletion events that remove a tenant's GitHub integration or forge issues events that insert fabricated issue data into the tenant's automation pipeline. This issue is fixed in version 111.42.13.

item.title: CVE-2026-135403 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.4
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.4 | Ever Gauzy is an open source business management platform for ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, and project management. Prior to 111.44.2, getTracker in packages/core/src/lib/throttler/throttler-behind-proxy.guard.ts accepts CF-Connecting-IP without verifying that a trusted Cloudflare edge supplied it; when CF-Connecting-IP is absent, app.set('trust proxy', true) can let an attacker-controlled X-Forwarded-For value determine req.ip. In deployments where a trusted intermediary does not overwrite these headers, or where the firewall permits direct API access, varying the applicable header on repeated POST /auth/login requests gives an unauthenticated remote attacker a distinct throttle bucket for each attempt, so the five-attempts-per-60-seconds limit does not trigger and no account lockout, CAPTCHA, or exponential backoff limits password guessing. This issue is fixed in version 111.44.2.

item.title: CVE-2026-135404 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.1
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.1 | Ever Gauzy is an open source business management platform for ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, and project management. Prior to 111.42.11, singleton-scoped ExportService stores the per-request identifiers this.idCsv and this.idZip as BehaviorSubjects and keeps derived directory names in instance fields, while singleton-scoped ImportService stores per-request paths in this._dirname and this._extractPath. Concurrent requests by different tenant administrators to /export, /export/template, /export/filter, or /import can interleave while asynchronous file operations are in progress, allowing one tenant's export archive to be delivered, overwritten, or deleted by another operation, or causing one tenant's import to read another tenant's uploaded CSV data and persist it under the wrong tenant. This issue is fixed in version 111.42.11.

item.title: CVE-2026-136329 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.8
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.8 | A flaw was found in the file-gif-load plugin in GIMP. When processing a specially crafted JIF image file, a 32-bit integer overflow occurs during the pixel buffer size calculation, while the zlib output limit is computed separately without wrapping. This leads to an undersized heap allocation, resulting in a heap-based buffer overflow when the compressed image data is decompressed. This issue can result in an application crash, leading to a denial of service, or potentially allow for arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-62151 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.8
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.8 | mysql_fdw builds string literals for queries sent to the remote MySQL server with an escaping routine that is not character-set aware. When the connection uses a multi-byte character set such as GBK, SJIS or Big5 and MySQL's default backslash escaping is in effect, a crafted value whose trailing byte is 0x5C absorbs the escaping backslash and leaves the following quote unescaped. The routine handles every pushed-down string constant, including ordinary WHERE-clause literals, so an authenticated user with only SELECT on a foreign table can break out of the literal and run arbitrary SQL on the remote MySQL server with the credentials of the user mapping. The issue is fixed in mysql_fdw 2.10.0. From mysql_fdw 2.10.0, mysql_fdw forces NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES into the session sql_mode and escapes string literals by doubling single quotes.

item.title: CVE-2026-62152 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.8
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.8 | mysql_fdw accepts several security-sensitive connection options from roles that are not superusers. A role with USAGE on the mysql_fdw foreign data wrapper can set init_command, which runs arbitrary SQL on the remote MySQL server at every connection, including connections made with other users' mappings on a shared foreign server. The same role can set mysql_default_file, ssl_key, ssl_cert, ssl_ca and ssl_capath, which name files read from the PostgreSQL server host, allowing server-side file reads and connection redirection. The issue is fixed in mysql_fdw 2.10.0. From mysql_fdw 2.10.0, only superusers can set init_command, mysql_default_file, ssl_key, ssl_cert, ssl_ca and ssl_capath.

item.title: CVE-2026-62153 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.4
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.4 | mysql_fdw inserts several values into statements sent to the remote MySQL server without escaping them: the dbname and table_name options in ANALYZE, the remote schema name and the LIMIT TO and EXCEPT table names in IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA, and the sql_mode option in the SET sql_mode command. A user who can create or alter foreign tables or foreign servers, or run IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA, can break out of the string literal and run arbitrary SQL on the remote MySQL server with the credentials of the user mapping. The issue is fixed in mysql_fdw 2.10.0. From mysql_fdw 2.10.0, mysql_fdw escapes these names and accepts only letters, digits, underscores and commas in sql_mode.

item.title: CVE-2026-62154 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.5
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.5 | During IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA, mysql_fdw copies column metadata returned by the remote MySQL server into the CREATE FOREIGN TABLE statements it runs locally without quoting it. The COLUMN_DEFAULT value is placed directly in the DEFAULT clause, and the name of the generated ENUM type is inserted unquoted. A malicious or compromised MySQL server, or an attacker who can tamper with the connection, can return crafted information_schema metadata and run arbitrary SQL in the local PostgreSQL session of the user who runs IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA. The issue is fixed in mysql_fdw 2.10.0. From mysql_fdw 2.10.0, mysql_fdw quotes these values before building the statements.

item.title: CVE-2026-62155 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | mongo_fdw builds the mongodb:// connection URI by inserting option values without percent-encoding them, so URI metacharacters (@ : / ? # & =) in a value are parsed as part of the URI structure. A role that is not a superuser but has USAGE on a foreign server can set the username and password options in its own user mapping. An @ or other metacharacter in those values can point the connection at a host the attacker controls, allowing connection redirection, credential capture and man-in-the-middle attacks. Server-level options such as the address, database and replica set can be injected the same way. The issue is fixed in mongo_fdw 5.6.0. From mongo_fdw 5.6.0, mongo_fdw builds the URI with the libmongoc URI API, which encodes credentials, and rejects URI metacharacters in the other option values.

item.title: CVE-2026-62156 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.5
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.5 | hdfs_fdw builds string literals for IN and = ANY(array) clauses pushed down to the remote Hive or Spark server without escaping single quotes. An authenticated user with only SELECT on a foreign table can supply a crafted array value that breaks out of the literal and changes the HiveQL query, which then runs on the remote server with the foreign server's credentials. The same release fixes two lower-severity issues: the JDBC connection string, including the trustStorePassword value, was written to logs, and credentials stayed in memory in cleartext after the connection was established. The issue is fixed in hdfs_fdw 2.4.0. From hdfs_fdw 2.4.0, hdfs_fdw escapes single quotes in these literals, masks trustStorePassword in logs and clears credentials from memory after connecting.

item.title: CVE-2026-62157 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | mongo_fdw converts _id values to 12-byte MongoDB ObjectIds with libbson functions that read a fixed number of bytes without checking the input length: 12 bytes for a bytea _id, and 24 characters for name-typed values and $oid fields in JSON. A shorter value causes a read past the end of the input, which can crash the PostgreSQL backend or include adjacent memory in the query sent to MongoDB. Any user who can supply an _id value or predicate on a foreign table can trigger it. The issue is fixed in mongo_fdw 5.6.0. From mongo_fdw 5.6.0, mongo_fdw accepts only valid 24-character hexadecimal ObjectIds and 12-byte bytea values.

item.title: CVE-2026-73517 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | KubeSphere 4.0.0 through 4.1.3 contains a command injection vulnerability in the terminal v1alpha2 file download endpoint where the path query parameter is inserted via fmt.Sprintf into sh -c tar commands executed inside the target container, and the DownloadFile handler fails to perform its own pods/exec authorization check. Attackers with only pod get permission, including built-in read-only project-viewer, workspace-viewer and cluster-viewer roles, can supply shell metacharacters in the path parameter to execute arbitrary commands inside any viewable container without holding pod exec permission.
